caption: The drawing depicts a large, round, gray stoneware teapot with a wide mouth at the top, a prominent spout at the front, and two small handles on either side, through which a metal wire handle with a wooden grip is attached. The main surface of the teapot is decorated with blue floral and leaf motifs on the front and sides, and the text "COWDEN & WILCOX HARRISBURG, PA" is centered beneath the spout and floral design. In the upper left and upper right corners of the main drawing, there are two smaller inset images showing different views of the same teapot: the left inset shows a side view with a lid on the teapot and floral motifs visible, and the right inset shows an angled view highlighting both the spout and the blue decoration. The color palette of the drawing is primarily gray and blue for the ceramic, black for the metal handle, brown for the wooden grip, and tan for the paper background.
title: Jug for Batter
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
